description: Set or clear a per-article scheduled publish time. Pass exactly one of scheduled_for (an ISO datetime) or clear_schedule=true. Scheduled APPROVED articles are published automatically by the 15-minute scheduler when autoPublish is on.

project_id.description: MotiBlog project id permitted by the current credential. Omit when a default project is configured.
